Rashi on Pesachim 87b:11:1.hebrew: בימי עוזיהו יותם - סיפיה דקרא, "ובימי ירבעם בן יואש מלך ישראל":
Rashi on Pesachim 87b:11:1.english: In the days of Uzziah, Jotham - The end of the verse [reads]: "and in the days of Jeroboam, son of Joash, king of Israel."

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:12:1.hebrew: כהן בית אל - כומר לעכו"ם:
Rashi on Pesachim 87b:12:1.english: Priest of Beth-El - A priest of idolatry.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:13:1.english: He remembers the compassion - We read [this in the text].

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:13:2.hebrew: כי לא אוסיף עוד ארחם - אע"ג דפורענותא הוא, אידכורי הוא מידכר שם רחמים:
Rashi on Pesachim 87b:13:2.english: For I will no more have compassion - Even though it is [a prophecy of] retribution, He nevertheless mentions the term "compassion."

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:13:3.hebrew: כי נשא אשא להם - לשון סליחה, ואתמוהי מתמה, ומיהו סליחה קא מידכר, וסיפיה דקרא דלעיל הוא:
Rashi on Pesachim 87b:13:3.english: That I should bear them - [This is] an expression of forgiveness, and it is phrased as a rhetorical question; nevertheless, He mentions forgiveness, and it is the end of the verse [cited] above.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:15:1.english: Rabbi Yochanan said from here: "And I will have compassion," etc., "and I will say to those who were not My people, 'You are My people'" - Those who were not of My people will attach themselves to them and become a people to Me.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:17:1.hebrew: אפילו דור - רשעים שאביהן יקללו, אל תלשינם:
Rashi on Pesachim 87b:17:1.english: Even a generation - [of] wicked people who curse their father, do not slander them.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:17:2.english: From Hosea - For he was punished for slandering Israel, even though they had sinned.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:18:1.english: [He] performed a charitable deed in that He scattered them - So that they [the nations] would not be able to destroy them [all] together.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:18:2.hebrew: יטפל לך תלמיד א' - להשיבך תשובה:
Rashi on Pesachim 87b:18:2.english: Let one student deal with you - to give you an answer:

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:19:1.english: Gappa of the Romans - He swore by an idol.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:19:2.english: With this we lie down and with this we rise up - We are constantly occupied with this thought.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:1:1.hebrew: דבלים - שתי דיבות, דומה בת דומה:
Rashi on Pesachim 87b:1:1.english: Diblaim - Two evil reports: [a woman of] ill repute, daughter of [a woman of] ill repute.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:20:1.english: He exiled them to Babylonia - For [the] Chaldeans are not cruel like other nations.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:20:2.hebrew: שעמוקה כשאול - ויפדם משם מהר, כמו שהבטיחם "מיד שאול אפדם":
Rashi on Pesachim 87b:20:2.english: That it is as deep as the netherworld - And He will ransom them from there quickly, as He promised them, "From the power of the netherworld I will ransom them."

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:20:3.english: That their language is close to the language of the Torah - And [thus] Torah will not be forgotten from them quickly.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:21:1.english: To their mother's house - Abraham came out from Ur Kasdim.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:22:1.hebrew: כסף מצרים - שבזזו ישראל בצאתם ממצרים, כדכתיב (שמות י״ב:ל״ו): ״וינצלו את מצרים״. ובימי רחבעם עלה שישק מלך מצרים ונטל את כל האוצרות:
Rashi on Pesachim 87b:22:1.english: The money of Egypt - [This refers to what] Israel plundered when they departed from Egypt, as it is written (Exodus 12:36): "And they despoiled Egypt." And in the days of Rehoboam, Shishak, king of Egypt, came up and took all the treasures.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:22:2.english: Before your eyes - That is to say, you saw a wondrous thing there that the eye turns to look at.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:2:1.english: For the king of Aram destroyed them and made them like the dust in threshing.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:3:1.english: And she conceived and bore a son, and the Lord said to him: Call his name Jezreel - For I am destined to sow them and scatter them in exile.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:5:1.hebrew: ארבעה קנינין גרסינן, ובית המקדש אחד מינייהו - קנינין חשובין בעניו לקרותם קנין לו, כאדם שטורח לקנות דבר החביב לו:
Rashi on Pesachim 87b:5:1.english: We read [the text as] "four acquisitions," and the Temple is one of them - [These are] acquisitions [that are] precious in His eyes, to call them an acquisition of His, like a person who takes pains to acquire something dear to him.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:7:1.hebrew: שלש גזירות - יזרעאל — דהיינו גולה — ולא עמי, ולא רוחמה:
Rashi on Pesachim 87b:7:1.english: Three decrees - Jezreel — that is, exile — and Lo-ammi, and Lo-ruhamah.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:9:1.hebrew: קיפח - קבר, האריך ימים מהם. על ידי שמתנשאים ברבנות הם מתים:
Rashi on Pesachim 87b:9:1.english: Outlasted - [He] buried [them], [i.e., he] outlived them. Because they exalt themselves in authority, they die.

Rashi on Pesachim 87b:9:2.english: Merited to be counted - As [the Gemara] derives below.

Tosafot on Pesachim 87b:20:1.hebrew: והגלה אותם לבבל - והא דאמר בגיטין (דף יז. ושם): "רחמנא בטולך או בטולא דבר עשו", אלמא בני עשו מעלו טפי — היינו לבתר דאתו חברי לבבל:
Tosafot on Pesachim 87b:20:1.english: "And He exiled them to Babylonia" - And [as for] that which [the Gemara] says in Gittin (17a, and there): "Merciful One, [either] in Your shadow or in the shadow of the son of Esau," implying [that] the descendants of Esau [i.e., Rome] are better — that was after the Chavrei [Zoroastrian priests] came to Babylonia.

Tosafot on Pesachim 87b:3:1.english: Jezreel - [He was so named] on account of the future, when they will be sown in exile.
